title: Benchmarking Adversarial Robustness to Bias Elicitation in Large Language Models: Scalable Automated Assessment with LLM-as-a-Judge
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of its core evaluation dimensions within its proposed benchmark (CLEAR-Bias). It benchmarks models on their ability to resist religious bias and stereotypes related to various groups, including Christians, Jews, Muslims, Hindus, and Buddhists.
